gen-flavors-gf-farro: Whimsical but a bit bossy, Flavors stamps its tall, chunky letters across the top. Farro follows in a compressed sans-serif with no stroke contrast at all, and that quiet uniformity is the strongest thing about the pair.
gen-flavors-gf-fragment-mono: Flavors towers over the line with chunky diagonals and a stubby-pencil x-height, loud and a little playful. Fragment Mono then lines up beneath it in a tall-waisted monospace, each letter set like a nail on a ruler.
gen-flavors-gf-genos: Tubelike lines of constant weight give Flavors its whole personality, fat and cheerful and a bit bossy. Genos tucks its glyphs in tightly with a high midline, so a long passage glides along without snagging on a closed bowl.
gen-flavors-gf-geom: Geom reads tall and friendly, its lofty lowercase band keeping each line easy to take in. And Flavors, with its marker-like constant-width line, supplies the loud, playful opening that the quieter sans lets stand.
gen-flavors-gf-inder: Whimsical stencil-cut letters of one steady width give Flavors a bold, cut-out-of-cardboard look. And Inder follows with a tidy sans where capitals and lowercase sit close in height, so a long passage moves along smoothly.
gen-flavors-gf-jaldi: Chunky, playful, impossible to ignore. Flavors draws every stroke at one thickness, while Jaldi's brushed, tightly packed sans-serif with its lifted x-height and gaping c gives the page a friendlier, lighter second voice.
gen-flavors-gf-kdam-thmor-pro: Horizontals as thick as the verticals give Flavors a blunt, toylike authority. And Kdam Thmor Pro does the quieter job, filling each line with full, modern sans bowls built for carrying the words.
gen-flavors-gf-krona-one: Rounded, chunky and a bit cheeky. Make Flavors small and its rounded-nib charm shrinks away, while Krona One as a big, loosely spaced sans with cast-iron stature would feel heavy if sized up too far.
gen-flavors-gf-magra: Flavors keeps its thickness steady around every curve, so its towering letters look cut from one piece. And Magra backs it up with a big-bodied sans whose lowercase words fill the line with confidence.
gen-flavors-gf-major-mono-display: Flavors comes in loud, with chunky diagonals and a stubby-pencil height that feels playful and commanding. Major Mono Display answers in neon-tube monospace with generous sidebearings, so a longer passage drifts slowly, one glowing character at a time.
